overwrite:
LD      E,0FFH
        LD      C,6
        CALL    BDOS                    ; direct input permits explicit Ctrl-C
        OR      A
        JR      Z,CTREAD
        CP      3
        JP      Z,CTABORT
        CP      13
        JR      Z,CTREAD
        CP      10
        JR      Z,CTREAD
        CP      'a'
        JR      C,CTANSWER
        CP      'z'+1
        JR      NC,CTANSWER
        SUB     32
verify:
LD E,0FFH
        LD C,6
        CALL BDOS
        OR A
        JR Z,CVVREAD
        CP 3
        JR Z,CVVABORT
        CP 13
        JR Z,CVVREAD
        CP 10
        JR Z,CVVREAD
        CP 'a'
        JR C,CVVANS
        CP 'z'+1
        JR NC,CVVANS
        SUB 32
name:
CTRENAME:
        LD DE,CTRASK
        CALL BC_PRINT
        XOR A
        LD (CTRLEN),A
        LD (CTROVER),A
CTRREAD:
        LD E,0FFH
        LD C,6
        CALL BDOS
        OR A
        JR Z,CTRREAD
        CP 3
        JP Z,CTABORT
        CP 13
        JP Z,CTRLINE
        CP 10
        JP Z,CTRLINE
        CP 8
        JR Z,CTRBACK
        CP 127
        JR Z,CTRBACK
        CP 'a'
        JR C,CTRSTORE
        CP 'z'+1
        JR NC,CTRSTORE
        SUB 32
CTRSTORE:
        LD (CTRCHAR),A
        LD A,(CTRLEN)
        CP 126
        JR NC,CTRFULL
        LD E,A
        LD D,0
        LD HL,CTRBUF
        ADD HL,DE
        LD A,(CTRCHAR)
        LD (HL),A
        LD HL,CTRLEN
        INC (HL)
        CALL BC_PCHAR
        JR CTRREAD
CTRFULL:
        LD A,1
        LD (CTROVER),A
        JR CTRREAD
CTRBACK:
        LD A,(CTRLEN)
        OR A
        JR Z,CTRREAD
        DEC A
        LD (CTRLEN),A
        LD DE,CTRERASE
        CALL BC_PRINT
        JR CTRREAD
